with_skill.expectation: States that a listed app cannot simply deactivate distribution and must discontinue its Marketplace listing instead

without_skill.expectation: States that the Slack Marketplace requires at least 10 installs on active workspaces before submission, not 5
States that the install count must stay at or above the threshold for the whole duration of the review
Gives the preliminary review as up to 10 business days and the functional review of a new app as up to 10 weeks
States that Slack does not expedite or accelerate reviews to match a launch date
Explains that after approval the vendor chooses when to publish, so the launch should not depend on approval landing on a given day
Flags channels:history (a *:history scope) as triggering enhanced review
States that each resubmission during the preliminary review resets the queue position
States that GitHub Issues alone is not acceptable support and that a channel requiring no new account is needed
States the expected support response time of 2 business days
Tells the user to give reviewers a way to install the app themselves plus test accounts with dummy data
Recommends a video demo covering install, OAuth, setup, use and uninstall
Warns that adding an unreviewed scope to the live install URL will make installs fail
Recommends a staging app cloned from the published app's manifest for reviewers to install
Recommends a video demo showing the new feature and how the new scope is used
Gives the functional review for updates to a published app as up to 6 weeks
Lists the AI disclosures for the Security & Compliance section: model used, data retention and use by the LLM, LLM data tenancy and LLM data residency
Requires a disclaimer on the landing page and long description that LLM output can be inaccurate
States that Slack data must not be used to train LLMs
Flags channels:history as triggering enhanced review
Suggests marking the new scope optional if the core app works without it, without moving core scopes to optional
States that Slack charges no fee for Marketplace inclusion
Names at least one listing-only distribution lever such as app suggestions via the slack-app-id meta tag or direct install from the listing

Warns that bulk indexing or storing message history is what Slack restricts, points to fetching messages when needed or the Real-time Search API, and notes Real-time Search is unavailable to an unlisted app
Recommends tracking installs and uninstalls with the app's own data, such as an OAuth install ledger or the app_uninstalled event
Requires requesting the team.billing:read bot scope and limiting installs to workspaces on paid Slack plans
States that the Slack API token must never be exposed to Flowmesh end users
States that the app must not request user-token history or files:read scopes to collect message and file data
Flags the nightly archive template as message export/backup that the platform must not enable
Warns that deactivating public distribution removes the app from every workspace except the original one
Names an uninstall spike as a trigger for Slack to contact the developer and possibly delist the app
Names unanswered support requests as a delisting risk and sets a 2-business-day support response
Recommends keeping developer and support contact details current and having at least one collaborator on the app
Does not refuse the MCP-only plan outright and states that an app whose only feature is an MCP server can list when its tools deliver meaningful work inside Slackbot conversations
States that mcp:connect must be required, not optional, when the MCP connection is the app's only function
Requires submission notes walking through install, authentication, a tool call and its response, plus a screenshot of a tool in a Slackbot conversation
Mentions the OAuth redirect https://oauth2.slack.com/external/auth/callback or running Fetch Tools in App Settings before submitting
States that repeated tool failures after listing can switch the app off automatically
Mentions the active-workspace install threshold as a prerequisite for submitting next month
